title: Scenario
description: Neutral, provider-independent description of how the emulator should behave for requests that match it. Kept intentionally minimal for v0.1 but extensible - see ARCHITECTURE.md#scenario-engine.

name.description: Scenario identifier, must match the filename (scenarios/<name>.yaml) and be listed in the provider manifest.

match.description: Conditions used by the scenario engine to select this scenario for an incoming canonical request. All present fields must match.

phone.description: Exact MSISDN this scenario triggers on (deterministic test identity, see specs/service-contract.md).

phonePattern.description: Regular expression alternative to an exact phone match.

amountAbove.description: Matches when the request amount is strictly greater than this value.

amountBelow.description: Matches when the request amount is strictly less than this value.

initialStatus.description: Status returned synchronously on payment creation.

finalStatus.description: Status the payment settles into (reported via status query and/or callback).

reason.description: Canonical failure/terminal reason code, mapped to a provider-specific error via mappings/errors.yaml.

httpStatus.description: Override the HTTP status code of the synchronous response.

latencyMs.description: Artificial latency before the synchronous response is returned.

callbackDelay.description: Delay before the callback is delivered, as a duration string (e.g. '30s', '2m'). Omit for immediate delivery.

callbackCount.description: Number of times to deliver the callback. Defaults to 1.

dropCallback.description: If true, the callback is scheduled but never actually delivered (simulates a missing callback).

duplicateCallback.description: If true, the same callback event is delivered twice with the same event id, to exercise idempotency handling.

invalidSignature.description: If true, the callback is delivered with a deliberately invalid signature header.

outOfOrderDelivery.description: If true and callbackCount > 1, later-state callbacks are delivered before earlier-state ones.

providerError.description: Free-form provider-specific error payload override, used verbatim by the mapping layer when set.

responsePayloadOverride.description: Free-form fields merged into the synchronous provider response.

callbackPayloadOverride.description: Free-form fields merged into the callback payload.
